cohort: Pregnant women undergoing cesarean section, divided into groups with and without uterine contractions.
finding: While JUN, FOS, and FOSL2 gene expression levels increased in the CS group with uterine contractions (though not statistically significant in absolute levels), a statistically significant correlation of JUN mRNA expression was found between maternal circulation and myometrial tissue in the contraction group (p<0.01).
cross-section timing: At the time of cesarean section
